author: DUYTRUYENTHONG
privacy: Aggregate counts only. No candidate or recruiter contacts, employer identities, private URLs, messages, CVs or receipt paths.
count_scope: Observed unique submission confirmations or verified email sending under the historically approved original, adjacent and stretch scope. Sending does not establish delivery.
provenance: Maintainer reconciliation of the private canonical ledger and immutable snapshots; incremental mailbox reviews retain their individual check dates. Raw evidence remains private.
measurement_limits: Not a fresh comprehensive inbox audit of all 120 applications
Interview invitations are not completed interviews or offers
Host-assisted campaign, not an autonomous kit replay
No matching reply is not rejection
